next.reason: 1985 VII.2.5.3 SR1: FILE STATUS 'Data-name-1 may be qualified.' 2023's FILE STATUS rules (§2023:12.4.5.8.3) neither restate nor forbid it; qualification is general: §2023:8.4.2.2.2 gives the qualified-data-name form 'data-name-1 [ data-qualifier ] …', §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 requires qualifiers for a non-unique name and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR2 states 'A name may be qualified even though it does not need qualification'. A qualified FILE STATUS data-name is accepted and means the same in both editions.
